subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage talks about the life and achievements of Emperor Babur. Born in 1483, Fargana, Uzbekistan, he was the founder of the Mughal Empire in India. He is a descendant of Taimur Lang and Genghis Khan. So, the blood of battle was naturally in him. He began his life as an emperor at the age of 12 only. He had a contest regarding the throne with his uncle. He defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipath in 1526, establishing Mughal rule. This great man died in 1531.
